summary: CDW LLC and CDW Finance Corp filed a preliminary 424B5 for a three-tranche senior unsecured note offering, terms (amounts, coupons, maturities) left blank. CDW Finance Corp and CDW LLC are issuers, CDW Corp guarantees on an unsecured senior basis. Net proceeds will retire $1.0 billion of 2.670% senior notes due December 2026 and fund a substantial portion of an unnamed acquisition plus general corporate purposes. Joint bookrunners are BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt takedown; watch pricing, tranche sizes and leverage impact tied to the acquisition.
